title: SessionListParams
description: Parameters for the session.list agent tool: list the items currently addressable in one terminal session. An empty list is valid when the pane has no recorded blocks.

limit.description: Maximum number of newest items to return.

result.title: SessionListResult
result.description: What session.list hands back: the items of one session, newest last. There is NO `text` here — an item's output is read with session.read, by the id listed here. An empty items list is honest for a pane with nothing recorded.

sessionId.description: The session these items belong to.

items.description: The items, each addressable by its id.

id.description: The item's id — what session.read takes.

command.description: The command or program the item is.

state.description: Whether the item is still running.

exitCode.description: The exit status of an exited item. Absent while it runs, and absent when the store recorded none.

lines.description: Lines of output the item holds, 0 when the output was not kept.

truncated.description: True when the byte-bound result omitted one or more listed items.

dropped.description: Bytes omitted from the complete list result because of the declared bound.

remaining.description: Bytes still omitted from the complete list result.

more.description: True when the session has more items than this page. Absent means false.
